description: The org's secretariat-specific manifest. Hosted at a URL referenced from the org's W3C DID document via a service entry of type `SecretariatOrg`. Carries the org's display name, list of relay endpoints, advertised channels (per visibility class), and reference to the org-wide roster meta-queue. Resolution flow: (1) caller resolves `did:web:<domain>` → fetches `.well-known/did.json`; (2) finds the service entry `{type: SecretariatOrg, serviceEndpoint: <url>}`; (3) fetches the orgDoc JSON at that URL; (4) reads channels and relays to address envelopes. Subscribers refresh the orgDoc on cadence (TTL hint optional) and treat it as the source of truth for what channels exist within the org. Sovereignty is preserved: the orgDoc is hosted by the org owner (typically on the same domain that anchors the did:web). No central registry.

did.description: The org's canonical DID. MUST match the DID whose well-known document references this orgDoc. Acts as the redundant self-reference (defends against substitution attacks on the hosted JSON).

name.description: Human-readable org name (e.g. `Themia`, `EquanimiTech`). For UI; not addressable.

description.description: Optional free-form description of the org. Markdown.

relays.description: Ordered list of relay endpoint URLs serving this org's channel queues. Subscribers try in order; first reachable wins. At least one entry required. Relays are dumb transports (see AGENTS.md invariant #4) — they never see plaintext. Per-channel relays may override via `tech.equanimi.secretariat.channelDef.relayHint`.

channels.description: Channels advertised by this org. Inclusion is governed by each channelDef's `visibility`: `public` channels appear in the org's public-facing orgDoc; `listed` channels appear only in member-authenticated fetches; `private` channels are omitted entirely (existence shared out-of-band). New members joining via invite-v2 receive a snapshot of channels they're eligible to see.

rosterRef.description: Canonical URI of the org-wide roster meta-queue (e.g. `did:web:themia.pro#_org:roster`). Carries `tech.equanimi.secretariat.rosterUpdate` records at the org level (membership beyond per-channel rosters — e.g. who is an org admin). Per-channel rosters live in their respective `<channel>:_meta` queues.

agents.description: Optional list of agent DIDs the org acknowledges as authorized participants (e.g. an org-wide secretariat agent, a webhook adapter agent). Authorization for specific channels is governed by per-channel rosters; this list is informational, useful for clients displaying agent provenance on envelopes.

preferredTransports.description: Bilateral-contract hint from AGENTS.md invariant #4: a steady-state correspondent who has Secretariat installed MAY negotiate stronger transports than the email bootstrap. Subscribers fall back through this list. Empty = `relay` only.

ttlSeconds.description: Suggested cache TTL for the orgDoc in seconds. Subscribers SHOULD refresh after this interval. Default (if absent): 86400 (24h).

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last orgDoc update.

signer.description: DID of the principal signing this orgDoc snapshot. MUST equal `did` (the org's owner) or a DID listed in the org's DID document as a verification method with appropriate capability (`assertionMethod`).

signature.description: Detached ed25519 signature over the canonical bytes of the orgDoc (excluding the `signature` field itself). Format: `ed25519:<base64>` with 64 raw bytes. Canonicalization: JSON serialization with sorted keys, no whitespace, signature field removed.
